title: River Development Agent Governed Executor Integration Executor Invocation Authorization Foundation
objective: Authorize an exact trusted DEV-304 active-admission enforcement result for a future separately governed executor invocation boundary while keeping the authorization result inert and granting no executor invocation, dispatch, execution, repository mutation, network, secret, shell, deployment, or external-side-effect authority.
invariants: The predecessor must be trusted, ready, and actively enforced.
The predecessor enforcement state must be ACTIVE_ADMISSION_ENFORCED.
The predecessor must remain an inert active-admission enforcement decision.
The predecessor must require a future executor invocation boundary.
Complete predecessor evidence and provenance continuity is required.
No inherited or downstream authority may already exist.
A successful DEV-305 result is an executor invocation authorization decision only.
A successful DEV-305 result remains inert data.
DEV-305 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-305 does not dispatch or execute an operation.
DEV-305 does not modify, stage, commit, push, deploy, access secrets, expand scope, execute arbitrary shell commands, perform network execution, or create external side effects.
A future separately governed executor invocation boundary remains required.
